description:
Gets SSL certificate information

HTTP: GET /v1/ssl/domains/:domain_id
Category: SSL
Required scopes: ssl:read
Returns: {status, data: object {has_ssl, domain_id, domain_name, issuer, common_name, valid_from, valid_until, status}}
Read-only.

domain_id.description: UUID of the domain — obtain it from GET /v1/domains
